description: This is a Python source file providing security utilities for a FastAPI application, including password hashing, JWT token creation/verification, and dependencies for route protection and scope validation.

methods.name: str hash_password(plain_password: str)
methods.description: Hashes a plaintext password using bcrypt, ensuring an effective 72-byte limit, returns the hash as a string.

methods.name: bool verify_password(plain_password: str, password_hash: str)
methods.description: Verifies a plaintext password against a stored bcrypt hash, returning True if matching, else False.

methods.name: str create_access_token(subject: Dict[str, Any], expires_minutes_override: Optional[int] = None)
methods.description: Creates a signed JWT access token with an expiration time, using subject payload and optional override for expiry minutes.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_access_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, raising HTTPException 401 on failure, returning payload if valid.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme))
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to extract and verify user info from JWT token, used for protected routes.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] require_admin_scope(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme))
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to verify that the JWT token has an admin scope; raises Authentication error if not.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(subject: Dict[str, Any], expires_minutes_override: Optional[int] = None)/

ctags.name: get_current_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_current_user(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme)) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: require_admin_scope
ctags.pattern: /^async def require_admin_scope(token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme)) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
